item: Row 367: the Markets and Insights tabs follow a language switch
key_paths: src/static/app-markets.js; src/static/app-insights.js; src/static/app-patterns.js; src/static/app-boot.js; configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt; configs/innerhtml_unescaped_sinks.txt; tests/markets_live_node_test.js; tests/test_markets_live.py; tests/insights_live_node_test.js; tests/test_insights_live.py; tests/oochart_legend_resize_node_test.js
summary: Eight app-markets.js and fifteen app-insights.js renderers leave the frozen list. Markets: repaintMarketBoards redraws both boards from held prices on a switch (never reads; a board not drawn is left alone; owed while loadDashboard re-reads emptied prices); ooChart exposes its view and _carryChartViews keeps zoom and hidden series by series symbol across the redraw; feed verdicts, retry line and ooTimeScope (labels, presets, scale options keeping the scale in use, attributes; marked data-i18n-dyn) are held. Insights: watches lines, keyword explorer (rows drawn once, buttons and tag editor held, typed tag kept), groups list and basis chip, concept browse via repaintConceptBrowse, ring gap and ring-load status with hover, convergences, lunar screen and single test, citation scan line; the Hide label Undo puts back is held. No new strings.
